Excessive tearing, medically known as epiphora, can be a frustrating and uncomfortable condition. It can interfere with daily activities, cause irritation, and even affect your vision. Fortunately, there are effective surgical solutions available at AestheticEye in Dayton, OH, to address this issue. Here’s what you need to know about repairing excessive tearing and how our expert oculoplastic surgeons can help.

Understanding Excessive Tearing

Excessive tearing can occur due to various reasons, including blocked tear ducts, eyelid malposition, or overproduction of tears. When the tear drainage system isn’t functioning properly, tears can overflow onto your face instead of draining through the nasal passages. This can lead to constant tearing, eye irritation, and even infections.

The Role of an Oculoplastic Surgeon

Oculoplastic surgeons, such as Dr. Ginger Henson and Dr. Jonathan Pargament, specialize in the anatomy and function of the eyelids and tear drainage system. Their expertise allows them to accurately diagnose the underlying cause of excessive tearing and recommend the most appropriate surgical solution.

Surgical Solutions for Excessive Tearing

There are several surgical options to address excessive tearing, depending on the root cause of the problem:

  1. Dacryocystorhinostomy (DCR): This is a common procedure used to treat blocked tear ducts. During DCR, the surgeon creates a new drainage pathway from the tear sac into the nasal cavity, bypassing the blockage. This allows tears to drain normally, reducing or eliminating excessive tearing.
  1. Punctoplasty: If the tear ducts are partially blocked, punctoplasty may be recommended. This procedure involves widening the opening of the tear ducts to improve tear drainage. It’s a less invasive option that can effectively reduce tearing.
  1. Eyelid Surgery: In cases where eyelid malposition (such as ectropion or entropion) contributes to excessive tearing, corrective eyelid surgery may be necessary. Adjusting the position of the eyelids can help restore proper tear drainage and reduce tearing.

Benefits of Surgical Treatment

Choosing surgical treatment for excessive tearing can provide significant benefits:

  • Improved Comfort: Surgical solutions can alleviate the constant irritation and discomfort associated with excessive tearing. You’ll no longer need to frequently wipe away tears or deal with the associated skin irritation.
  • Enhanced Vision: By addressing the underlying cause of excessive tearing, surgery can improve your vision and reduce the risk of infections or other complications.
  • Long-Term Relief: Surgical treatments offer long-lasting results, providing you with a permanent solution to excessive tearing.

Personalized Care at AestheticEye

At AestheticEye, we understand that each patient’s needs are unique. Our experienced oculoplastic surgeons will conduct a thorough evaluation to determine the cause of your excessive tearing and develop a personalized treatment plan. We prioritize your comfort and safety, ensuring you receive the highest standard of care.

If you’re tired of constantly tearing up and are seeking a lasting solution, we invite you to schedule a consultation with Dr. Henson or Dr. Pargament at AestheticEye in Dayton, OH. Let us help you regain comfort and clarity with our specialized surgical treatments for excessive tearing.
